typography.usage: Residency proposition and chapter openings; keep the soft serif character.
Proposal narrative, practical requirements and schedules.

recognitionRules: Use Fraunces display typography for the residency proposition and Alegreya Sans for delivery detail.
Keep the warm peach page ground, plum reading ink and a generous first-page title interval; the open painted vessel is supporting source artwork.
Separate the creative premise, participant experience and production requirements.
Treat the proposal as an invitation to review, not an announced residency.

principles: Invite attention before offering interpretation; keep object facts and imaginative response distinct.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A place to make, and time to notice what making changes.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid prescribing a viewer’s feelings or implying unverified provenance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Look at the edge, then read the record.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use COMMON MATERIAL in the source’s soft Fraunces display face, with no symbol. Keep the wordmark text editable and provide a licensed substitute if the source font cannot travel.
invariants: Use Fraunces display typography for the residency proposition and Alegreya Sans for delivery detail.
Keep the warm peach page ground, plum reading ink and a generous first-page title interval; the open painted vessel is supporting source artwork.
Separate the creative premise, participant experience and production requirements.
adaptations: Use the display face sparingly in schedule-heavy pages.
Adapt the subject and location without changing the proposal’s reading hierarchy.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
